items.note: Each comma in pasted or composed text now ends a token. Text past `maxItems`, or text that `create` refuses, stays in the field. TokenField's main function then ran past 140 lines, over `check:size`'s 120-line cap, so 1a6aa15325 moves the draft handling into `useTokenDraft` in `tokenDraft.ts`.
